dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped rings are distributed across the dorsal surface. The central-most 'O' structure features a jagged, high-contrast perimeter with a sharp gradient transition from a dark-grey exterior to a light-cream interior. Posterior structures exhibit interlocking 'C' geometries with variable edge thicknesses.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Localized clusters of solid high-intensity cream pixels are visible along the lower-lateral boundary. These asymmetrical clusters show high core pixel concentration without internal gradients, particularly in the anterior-ventral region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent dorsal macro-annuli form an obtuse scalene triangle. A near-linear spatial relationship exists between the central dorsal ring and two high-intensity blobs located along the lower right-hand margin.

other_distinctive_markers: A continuous, low-intensity dark pigment region covers the entire anterior snout area, creating a high-contrast boundary against the adjacent light-mottled textures.
